messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sundboe,

Fjorn Consulting's executive-search work across energy, utilities, EPC and infrastructure aligns with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy and infrastructure growth require institutional trust, regulatory coordination and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile and open to senior cross-border appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
